proposed_entry.id_note: The Decider proposed ЯID-0005-WILD. 0005 is SCOUT's (ЯID-0005-KM02) and ЯIDs are never reused. The check is computed (first 20 bits of SHA-256('ЯID-0006') in Crockford base32 = 02WG) and Crockford base32 has no I or L, so 'WILD' can never be a valid check. Next free number: ЯID-0006-02WG (matches PR #4 manifest next_rid). 'WILD' stays in the name.
